dem.attribution: Elevation: ÍslandsDEM v1.0 © Náttúrufræðistofnun (Natural Science Institute of Iceland), Veðurstofa Íslands, Polar Geospatial Center — CC BY 4.0 (modified: resampled, coastline-masked, vertical exaggeration). Based on ArcticDEM (DEM courtesy of the Polar Geospatial Center).

notes: DEM: ÍslandsDEM 2 m (ArcticDEM mosaic, median of multi-date strips; it is a surface model, so buildings in the town and the harbour piers are in it) mosaicked from tiles 80+81 and sampled in Web-Mercator space with pyproj (EPSG:8088 -> WGS84). height.bin = 1024x1002 grid at the linspace nodes of meta.mercator (as tools/terrain.py), Gaussian area prefilter (sigma 3.3 m) + normalised bilinear sampling; land = the DEM's own nodata coastline (sea is nodata in ÍslandsDEM), components < 2 cells dropped, land floor 1.0 m; sea = -min(2 + 0.08*dist_m, 60) as in tools/coast_fix.py. Harbour basin, east-of-pier water and the entrance channel are water and connected to the open sea (see checks.harbour). The new coastline adds land mainly on the north/west cliffs that the old EOX-colour mask (land.png) had classified as sea because the cliffs are in shadow; land.png was left untouched and is now stale for heimaey. normal.png = 4096x4006 px at pixel centres over the same bbox as sat.jpg, from the 2 m DEM (bilinear, Gaussian 0.6 px), heights x 1.35, spacing width_m/W x height_m/H (mercator scale x cos(lat_c)), sea surface at 0 m for the gradient, water pixels = (0,1,0) -> rgb (128,255,128). Old height.bin kept as height_v1.bin (height_raw.bin = original terrarium also kept). WARNING: re-running tools/coast_fix.py heimaey would rebuild height.bin from height_raw.bin and undo this. meta.json: added normal_map / dem_source / imagery_source / coast_source, updated h_min/h_max, appended the ÍslandsDEM credit (the terrarium credit is now obsolete for heimaey; the coast_fix key is stale). Imagery not replaced: (1) Náttúrufræðistofnun «Grunnkort Loftmynd NÁTT» 25 cm orthophoto is CC BY 4.0, but its tile index (17,211 tiles, WFS loftmyndir:grunnkort_loftmynd_nidurhal) and the 607 single frames (…_nidurhal_stakar) reach no further south than 63.76 N — Heimaey is not covered; (2) OpenAerialMap: no images in the bbox; (3) Loftmyndir ehf orthophotos are commercial — skipped; (4) newer EOX s2cloudless years are CC BY-NC-SA — not allowed. ArcticDEM 2 m mosaic (PGC, AWS pgc-opendata-dems) not used: its Dataverse terms say "Creative Commons CC4 license" with unspecified "additional/modified terms", and OpenTopography restricts 2 m products to education/research users — unclear for commercial video; ÍslandsDEM is the same data with a clear CC BY 4.0 licence. sat.jpg stays EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016 (~10 m), so colour stays soft; the sharpness gain comes from geometry + lighting (normal.png).

consistency.dem_vs_EOX_alignment: NCC of DEM shaded relief vs sat.jpg luminance (band-pass) peaks at <=2 px east, <=1 px south (~2-4 m) in 3 windows (Eldfell, north cliffs, south) -> no re-registration needed
